NINE_EVENT_PROOF.extension_rule: Extend subset tree to all residual events with nonnegative edges
NINE_EVENT_PROOF.pointwise_hunter_proof: For each outcome present in k>=1 events, the induced subgraph of a tree has at most k-1 edges. Sum this inequality over outcomes.
NINE_EVENT_PROOF.scope: Every R3 support with at least nine type-0 tickets; select any nine
NINE_EVENT_PROOF.threshold_tree_proof: Descending Kruskal retains a spanning forest of each nested G_k; rank(G_k) >= rho(e_k) since SUM C(r_j+1,2) <= C(SUM r_j+1,2).
